name: marquee-promo
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Chrome Web Store marquee promotional tile for "Gmail Shortcuts". Finished canvas exactly 1400×560 pixels, wide 5:2 landscape.
Primary request: Create the wide marquee companion to the supplied existing small promotional tile. Keep its recognizable branding and copy, redesign the layout to exploit the panoramic space.
Input image 1: existing small promo tile, a STYLE AND BRAND REFERENCE only, not a canvas to stretch. Preserve its red clock identity, strong black sans-serif lettering, warm off-white background and tactile ivory/red keyboard keys. Generate a new wide composition.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory #F7F6F2, subtle soft studio shadows, spacious editorial productivity advertising, beautifully sharp typography, flat front-facing overall layout.
Composition: generous 65px safe margins on every side of the final 1400×560 canvas. Left roughly 65% has small red rounded-square clock icon beside "Gmail Shortcuts" near upper-left. Below, very large bold headline in two lines exactly "Less clicking." then "More doing." Below headline, one neat medium-size line exactly "Keyboard shortcuts for Gmail". Right roughly 30%: a sculptural but restrained arrangement of three large physical keyboard keycaps occupying vertical center: primary coral-red keycap "T" in white, two ivory keycaps ";" and lowercase "g" in black. Give keys subtly rounded corners, tactile depth and realistic soft contact shadows as in reference. Clear empty gutter between text and keys. All elements comfortably fit inside panorama. The full headline must remain on the left and not overlap keys.
Exact text, only:
"Gmail Shortcuts"
"Less clicking."
"More doing."
"Keyboard shortcuts for Gmail"
Key legends: "T", ";", "g".
Color palette: near-black text, warm ivory, coral-red #EA4335, white icon and T legend. Match supplied reference.
Constraints: render the entire 1400×560 promotional canvas edge to edge, no outer frame. Crisp readable type and exact spelling. Keep clock as a simple white outlined circular clock on a red rounded square. No inbox mockup, no extra copy, no Google envelope logo, no Chrome logo, no official affiliation or endorsement, no badges, no install button, no gradients, no watermark. Do not squeeze or stretch the small reference. Create a professionally composed wide marquee.
